name: Hashiba Sousuke
source:
A member of the 13th Division. He is a highly skilled detective and strong keeper, but his tendency to violate rules (albeit less than Ruka) has led to his assignment to the 13th Division. A lone wolf, he does everything by himself. 

Like Ruka, he has a strong obsession with the cult, especially Schwarld.

[spoiler] Fuyumi's long lost older brother. [/spoiler]
